body:
Ok, I just figured it out. Apparently when running the project from the editor, the FileDialog has access by default to the file system, when exported this is no longer the case. So the solution is to specify the _Access_ of the dialog. 

Adding the following solves the issue:
 ```
dialog.access = FileDialog.ACCESS_FILESYSTEM
```

Thinking the access would work the same as what I got from the editor was the confusion. 

NOTE: For saving a file or opening a directoy (i.e. FILE_MODE_SAVE_FILEa and FILE_MODE_OPEN_DIR) I did not have to set the access explicitly in the FileDialog. Only when  FILE_MODE_OPEN_FILE or FILE_MODE_OPEN_ANY that I tested.

I am not sure if it is intended this way or if there is an unintended discrepancy or if other platforms work differently. 

Sorry to bother. Closing the issue.
And btw, Godot is always awesome :)
